assumptions: Fuzz Select depth 3 spans S1 to S4 without a silent zero pole. UM depth 4 retains the existing empty-zero convention.
Fuzz rate-factor x2.558 uses the same provisional exponential host law as Deci; host feedback evaluation/clipping need A/B audition.
Uncaptured Math operand and Mixer baselines default to zero and remain controls. Only the Fuzz feedback edge uses a previous-block value.
Shared chain excludes Verb and reserved dynamic FX by default; those retain direct master returns.
Scheps wet/dry uses the captured outer Math: schertler mix times external source times 0.66.
